answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because dune only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, thread is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any opal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
